reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports improved thermal stability and oxide scale spallation resistance in Y-Hf co-doped EHEA coatings, but it does not address bulk alloy processing, creep resistance, or room-temperature corrosion, which are key premises of the hypothesis. The extrapolation from coatings to bulk and to creep/mechanical loading conditions is unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Y and Hf co-doping improves thermal stability of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA coatings
Y and Hf co-doping improves hot corrosion oxide scale spallation resistance in coatings
Y and Hf co-doping does not change the microstructure morphology and phase structure of the coatings
Benefits observed in laser-clad coatings will translate to bulk AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA under different conditions
